continuity_scope: Narrow publisher-metadata pass bound to 栗本薫 (Kurimoto Kaoru)'s グイン・サーガ１　豹頭の仮面 (Guin Saga 1: Leopard Mask), Hayakawa electronic edition product 0000610001, first-volume only. Excludes the 100+ volume series, post-Kurimoto continuations, anime/manga/game adaptations, and all translation continuities.

work_or_witnesses.work: The Guin Saga Book 1: The Leopard Mask

coverage_rule: Three named individual characters and three direct relations supported by Hayakawa's official first-volume synopsis only. No unsupported internal terminology or events beyond that synopsis are asserted.
omissions: All characters not named in the official first-volume synopsis; all later-volume, continuation-author, anime/manga/game, and translation-specific claims.
Peoples, kingdoms, roles, magic, artifacts, places, and series structures not directly necessary to identify the synopsis setting.
uncertainties: This is a narrow authoritative-metadata pass, not a primary-text chapter pass; claims are restricted to the publisher's synopsis.
Original Japanese scripts are retained alongside Hepburn-like romanization; licensed English names are not treated as a merged continuity.
The synopsis contains invasion, pursuit, demons, and child endangerment. Broader content warnings and spoilers are deferred without a full witness.
evidence_basis: Hayakawa's official synopsis directly names Guin, Rinda, and Remus and describes their opening rescue. The licensed English record corroborates the translation's existence but does not supply story claims.

supports: First-volume title/author, Paro/Mongaul premise, Rinda/Remus twin status, and Guin's rescue.
